tasks.title: Fix Admin: Mod -> Top Style Guide escalation, serialize workspace-state.json writes, and quarantine corrupt state files
tasks.objective: Prevent Admin: Mod from approving, overwriting, or clearing Admin: Top Style Guide decisions, eliminate lost updates during concurrent GitHub pushes, and stop silent resets on corrupt state JSON.
tasks.proposed_changes: Trim and validate status strings prior to role checks, require `minRole: "top"` whenever `prevDec.status` OR `nextStatus` is `approved` / `not_applicable`, derive `approved_by` from verified Top Admin identity, serialize `workspace-state.json` writes with an async lock, re-read fresh `workspace-state.json` after GitHub API calls in `push`, and throw `500 STYLE_GUIDE_STATE_CORRUPT` instead of returning `emptyState()` on JSON parse errors.
steps: In `lib/style-guide-admin.js:329-349`, return `emptyState()` strictly on `err.code === "ENOENT"`; throw `StyleGuideAdminError("Workspace state file is unreadable or corrupt.", { status: 500, code: "STYLE_GUIDE_STATE_CORRUPT" })` on parse/read errors.

Add an in-process promise queue `withWorkspaceLock(storageDir, fn)` wrapping `saveStyleGuideAdminUpdates`, `resetStyleGuideAdminDecisions`, and the final state write in `pushStyleGuideWorkspaceToGithub`.

In `saveStyleGuideAdminUpdates` (`lines 955-1052`), normalize `nextStatus = typeof item.status === "string" ? item.status.trim() : prevDec.status` against `VALID_STATUSES` first, then check if ANY item has `prevDec.status` OR `nextStatus` in `["approved", "not_applicable"]`; if true, require `await reverifyPlatformAdminInTx(tx, { userId: actorUserId, sessionId: actorSessionId, minRole: "top" })` and bind `nextDec.approved_by` to the verified Top Admin email/handle.

In `pushStyleGuideWorkspaceToGithub` (`lines 1650-1668`), re-read current `wsState` inside `withWorkspaceLock` after GitHub API commit creation and merge `last_github_push` (`pushed_at_revision: snap.wsState.revision`) without overwriting newer `overrides_by_id`.
tasks.side_effects: Corrupt `workspace-state.json` files will fail loudly (`500`) for safe operator inspection instead of silently wiping overrides; `Admin: Mod` can still save `draft` edits on `unanswered` and `draft` items.
acceptance_criteria: `Admin: Mod` receives `403` when sending `"status": "approved "`, omitting `status` on an `approved` item, or setting an `approved` item to `draft`/`unanswered`.

Concurrent `POST /api/admin/style-guide/save` completed while `POST /api/admin/style-guide/push` is awaiting GitHub API responses survives in `workspace-state.json` with `unpushed_changes_since_last_push: true`.
tasks.tests_required: Extend `tests/style-guide-admin.integration.cjs` with Mod privilege-escalation negative tests, concurrent push+save test, and corrupt JSON test.

tasks.title: Block synthetic test customer from platform_roles grants, make GET /api/admin/test-customer read-only, and harden last-Top DB invariant
tasks.objective: Prevent `usr_sa_top_admin_test_customer` from ever holding `Admin: Top` / `Mod` roles, counting as a human Top Admin in `protect_last_top_admin()`, or mutating database state on `GET`.
tasks.proposed_changes: Reject `SYNTHETIC_TEST_CUSTOMER_USER_ID` on role/status/vendor-owner mutations, refactor `getAdminTestCustomerStatus` (`GET`) to read-only SQL, and add an additive migration excluding synthetic `.invalid` sandbox accounts from `platform_roles` and `count_eligible_active_top_admins()`.
steps: In `server/admin-routes.js:4349-4560`, reject `targetUserId === SYNTHETIC_TEST_CUSTOMER_USER_ID` (`400 SYNTHETIC_TEST_ACCOUNT_IMMUTABLE`) in `/api/admin/accounts/role` and `/api/admin/accounts/status`.
In `lib/admin-test-customer.js:185-255`, make `getAdminTestCustomerStatus` strictly read-only (`SELECT`), running `ensureSyntheticTestCustomerInTx` only on `POST` actions (`enter`, `seed`, `reset`).

Add additive migration `030_harden_synthetic_sandbox_and_rls.sql` adding `ALTER TABLE platform_roles ADD CONSTRAINT platform_roles_no_synthetic_test_user_chk CHECK (user_id <> 'usr_sa_top_admin_test_customer')` and updating `count_eligible_active_top_admins()` to exclude `usr_sa_top_admin_test_customer`.

`GET /api/admin/test-customer` executes zero `INSERT`/`UPDATE`/`DELETE` statements.
PostgreSQL `platform_roles` rejects `INSERT` of `usr_sa_top_admin_test_customer` at the constraint layer.

tasks.title: Prevent feature_controls unknown-key rollbacks and DB errors from failing OPEN on hidden/staff_beta/sharing surfaces
tasks.objective: Ensure additive forward-migration keys in `feature_controls` do not invalidate known feature states during rollbacks, and ensure genuine `stateUntrusted` DB failures fail CLOSED on gated read/sharing endpoints.
tasks.proposed_changes: Treat unrecognized `feature_key` rows as logged warnings without setting `stateUntrusted = true`, and fail closed (`hidden` / `503` / neutral `404`) on optional/beta/sharing surfaces when `stateUntrusted === true`.
steps: In `lib/feature-controls.js:1235-1312`, record a rate-limited diagnostic warning when `unknownKeys.length > 0`, but keep `stateUntrusted = false` as long as known feature rows parse cleanly.

In `lib/feature-controls.js:1418-1438` and `1876-1928`, when `stateUntrusted === true` (actual DB query error or corrupt row on a known key), fail closed (`503 FEATURE_CONTROLS_UNAVAILABLE` / effective `hidden`) for `customer_profile`, `greatest_hits_collections`, `unlisted_collection_sharing`, `shared_collection_photos`, `admin_style_guide_workspace`, and `staff_beta`-configured features while preserving core `/api/trucks` catalog resilience.
In `lib/customer-profile.js:3014-3019, 4291-4297`, return the neutral unavailable response if `systemFeatureStates?.stateUntrusted === true`.
tasks.side_effects: Update any test in `tests/feature-controls.integration.cjs` that previously expected an unknown `feature_key` row to force `stateUntrusted = true`.
acceptance_criteria: Inserting an unknown `feature_key` row into `feature_controls` leaves `hidden` and `staff_beta` enforcement intact across all 14 registered features.
When `feature_controls` query fails (`stateUntrusted === true`), `/s/<token>` returns neutral `404` and `/api/me/profile` returns `503` rather than exposing hidden data.

Document the complete `BITESHARK_PAUSE_WRITES` scope list in `docs/VPS_OPERATIONS.md`.

tasks.title: Close shared-collection moderation suppression bypasses on photo re-attachment, collection updates, and multi-share previews
tasks.objective: Ensure moderator/Top-Admin photo and content suppressions cannot be bypassed by re-attaching the same photo, editing an already-shared collection, or creating a second low-disclosure share link.
tasks.proposed_changes: Block suppressed `recorded_source_photo_id` / `sha256_hex` in `attachPhotoToCollectionEntry`, preserve suppressed `sha_*` evidence files for moderator inspection, enforce `suppressed_content_sha256` (including photo attachments) in `updateOwnerCollection`, and `BOOL_OR` disclosures across active/reported shares in `listAdminSharedModerationQueue`.
steps: In `attachPhotoToCollectionEntry` (`lib/customer-profile.js:4013-4150`), reject with `403 PHOTO_SUPPRESSED_BY_MODERATION` if `customer_collection_photo_attachments` contains a `moderation_status = "suppressed"` row for `(user_id, recorded_source_photo_id)` or matching `sha256_hex`, and retain suppressed derivative files on disk (`readAdminReportedSharedPhoto` at `line 4461` should allow inspecting `moderation_status = "suppressed"` attachments).

Include sorted `photo_attachment_id` / `sha256_hex` values in `computeCollectionContentDigest` (`line 1478`) and enforce `suppressed_content_sha256` inside `updateOwnerCollection` (`lines 1950-2020`) when shares exist.

In `listAdminSharedModerationQueue` (`lines 3567-3621`), aggregate `include_display_name`, `include_bio`, `include_preferred_area`, and `include_shared_photos` across all active or reported shares on the collection.
tasks.side_effects: None for un-moderated collections.
acceptance_criteria: Re-attaching a `suppress_attachment` photo returns `403` until `Admin: Top` runs `reinstate_attachment`.
Updating a shared collection to match `suppressed_content_sha256` returns `403 SUPPRESSED_CONTENT_BYPASS_BLOCKED`.
Moderator queue displays curator `display_name`/`bio` whenever ANY active or reported share on the collection enables those disclosures.

tasks.title: Commit non-retryable ineligibility on under-14 POST /api/me/sharing-eligibility submissions
tasks.objective: Prevent under-14 DOB submissions on `/api/me/sharing-eligibility` from rolling back to `"unknown"` and allowing immediate adult-DOB retries.
tasks.proposed_changes: Commit `ineligible_under_18` inside `withTransaction` using the `{ deniedError }` return pattern before throwing `403 AGE_INELIGIBLE` (and optionally suspend account / revoke active sessions per product/legal decision).
steps: In `lib/customer-profile.js:2263-2295`, persist `ineligible_under_18` into `customer_sharing_eligibility` when `evalRes.under_14` is true and return `{ deniedError }` so `withTransaction` commits before throwing `403 AGE_INELIGIBLE`.

Apply product/legal decision (`Decisions Required`) on whether `< 14` input on `/api/me/sharing-eligibility` also sets `auth_users.age_eligibility_status = "ineligible"` + `disabled_at = now()` and revokes `auth_sessions`.
tasks.side_effects: Zero raw birth-date values are stored in any column or log.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting a 12-year-old DOB to `POST /api/me/sharing-eligibility` returns `403` AND persists `ineligible_under_18` so an immediate retry with an adult DOB is also rejected (`403`).

tasks.objective: Make `BITESHARK_PAUSE_WRITES=all` halt all non-emergency disk/DB writes (including 5 MiB photo uploads and onboarding evidence) and block all mutating requests sent from read-only Admin Preview.

tasks.title: Isolate browser_untrusted diagnostic eviction pool, prevent actor_id spoofing, and harden secret/cookie regex redaction
tasks.objective: Prevent unauthenticated browser telemetry from evicting `server_verified` or issue-linked incidents, block `actor_id` spoofing, and close underscore word-boundary and sandbox-cookie redaction gaps.

steps: In `lib/diagnostics.js:1008-1025`, cap `browser_untrusted` incident groups at `150` and restrict untrusted eviction strictly to `trust_source = 'browser_untrusted' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM support_issue_diagnostic_links l WHERE l.diagnostic_group_id = diagnostic_incident_groups.id)`; also exclude linked groups from `server_verified` eviction when unlinked groups exist.
In `server/admin-routes.js:695-712`, delete `actor_id`, `actor_role`, and `session_id` from incoming `body.safe_context` before merging verified `req.user?.id`.

In `lib/diagnostics.js:85-190` and `public/diagnostics-client.js:69-82`, replace `\b` before `password|secret|token|cookie|session` with `(?:^|[^A-Za-z0-9]|_)`, scrub `__Host-bs_admin_test_session`, and catch 22+ char base64url secrets.
Update `deploy/bin/biteshark-staging2-ctl:144` and `deploy/install-staging-release.sh:737` to redact `(__Host-(?:truckly_session|bs_admin_test_session)=)[^;\s"']+`.
tasks.side_effects: None.
acceptance_criteria: 200 distinct unauthenticated `POST /api/diagnostics/report` fingerprints cannot evict a single `server_verified` group or unlink `support_issue_diagnostic_links`.
`sanitizeDiagnosticText("auth_secret=abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv12")` and `unsubscribe_token=...` redact 100% of secret values, and `staging2-ctl` redacts `__Host-bs_admin_test_session`.

tasks.title: Add Subresource Integrity (SRI) and non-blocking load to Leaflet CDN assets (or vendor locally) and add HTML Content-Security-Policy headers

In `server/app.js:248-252` (and `/admin` HTML handler), add strict `Content-Security-Policy` (`default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'`) on `/admin` and `/login.html`, and `object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'` baseline CSP on `/`.
tasks.side_effects: Verify zero inline `onclick` attributes exist in `public/admin.html`, `public/admin.js`, `public/admin-style-guide.js`, and `public/login.html` before enabling `script-src 'self'` on those two pages!

`GET /admin` and `GET /login.html` emit strict `Content-Security-Policy` with zero browser console CSP errors.
tasks.tests_required: Assert SRI & CSP headers in `tests/map-resilience.test.cjs` and run `tests/admin-portal-browser.e2e.cjs`.
